lineage.description: Administrative boundary and population data from the 2010 census were spatially intersected with a 1km coastal buffer derived from coastline geometry to estimate the proportion of population and area within coastal proximity. The analysis was conducted for 22 Pacific Island Countries and Territories to support coastal risk and vulnerability assessments.
